subject: reasoning
question:
Find the total number of cubes in the figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4444077c0fb3456eae8b633161096158ace171828980e95db07cf9baa3f9bbc3.png]
solution:
The number of cubes is as follow.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfe1e9c552b0fb52b7e091ae18848c1aff4ec018b6607a7a1c7552ee8c666e95.png] 

Cubes in first row = 6

Cubes in second row = 3

Cubes in third row = 1

⇒ 6 + 3 + 1 = 10

Hence, the correct answer is **"10".**
